local_context.value: Mulberry has a humid subtropical climate (Koppen Cfa); elevation 112 ft. NWS Tampa Bay: the West Central Florida rainy (thunderstorm) season runs May 25 to October 10; late May through June, hail, damaging winds, waterspouts, heavy rainfall and frequent lightning are common (https://www.weather.gov/tbw/rainyseason). Phosphate rock was found in the Peace River in 1886 and mining replaced logging; the phosphate industry still dominates the economy, and Mosaic's Nichols mine is about two miles east of the city. Water covers 0.70 sq mi of the city's area. No official median year built was found.
